experiences.title: QA Analyst
experiences.subtitle: FX Digital
workDescription: Assigned to various project teams as an internal QA with a primary focus on the video player
Daily activites included deploying builds and executing multiple tests on Web, Mobile and CDTV devices
Automated scripts were written in Gherkin and executed using an in-house automation framework based on Puppeteer
Automation was also performed on BrowserStack (real devices) using WebdriverIO
Feature requests and internal changes were completed with a strong focus on test coverage, tooling, and collaboration
